about: Reason codes the till accepts, by action. Auditors see the code and who used it. Add or retire codes here; no code change needed.

discount_override.PRICE_MATCH: Matching a quoted or competitor price
discount_override.SERVICE_RECOVERY: Making up for a service failure

refund.CHANGED_MIND: Customer changed their mind within the return window
refund.WRONG_ITEM: Wrong item billed or handed over
refund.RX_ISSUE: Lens does not work for the prescription

remake.PROGRESSIVE_NON_ADAPTATION: Customer could not adapt to progressive lenses

remake_cost_bearer.customer: Customer pays the lab cost (bill a normal lens-only sale instead)

void.SHOPIFY_REJECTED: Shopify rejected the order and it cannot be fixed
void.BILLING_ERROR: Billed in error before the order reached Shopify
